# prepare main branch support

Make every git helper independent of the trunk being called `master`. The author planned to rename the default branch of their repositories to `main` ("I have a plan to switch from master to main, so, some scripts are not ready for that"), and any script or alias with `master` hard-coded would break or, worse, keep operating on a stale branch.

Expected: the trunk is always discovered (`git default`, i.e. the remote's HEAD) and never assumed; a repository whose remote HEAD is not set is handled by asking the remote; the only literal `master` left is a documented last-resort fallback, or none; new repositories start on `main`.
